sources.title: Rammus Build Guide: My IMMORTAL Rammus Build

passive.name: Spiked Shell
passive.text: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

spells.name: Powerball
spells.text: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

spells.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spells.text: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.

spells.name: Frenzying Taunt
spells.text: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.

spells.name: Soaring Slam
spells.text: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.

damage.value: Rammus deals burst magic damage when Soaring Slam lands.

archetype.value: Rammus is a tank who builds armor and sustain to fight without relying on others for damage.

axis.value: Rammus uses bushes and fog of war to charge Q, then commits with W, E, and R.

winCondition.value: Rammus wins by sustaining through fights while dealing enough damage to kill enemies himself.

spikes.why: Rammus gains reflected damage that benefits from his bonus armor.
Rammus gains reflected damage, a burn effect, health, and armor.

spikes.at: When Rammus has Powerball and Soaring Slam ready
spikes.why: Rammus can knock up enemies near the center by casting Soaring Slam during Powerball.

bait.why: After Rammus spends Frenzying Taunt, its 12-second cooldown leaves Rammus without that taunt.

mistakes.value: Rammus misses the potential knockup by casting Soaring Slam outside Powerball.
